transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Meera. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Meera, I am so frustrated. My current data plan is way too small and I keep hitting the limit every single month, which is costing me a fortune in overage charges!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you've been dealing with those overage charges. I can certainly help you find a plan that better fits your needs.
Customer: I just want something with more data so I don't have to worry about this anymore.
Agent: I can definitely look into that for you. Before we access your account details, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: Yes, it is 86037035. My name is Fatima Sharma.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Sharma. I see your current plan. I recommend our Unlimited Data Plan, which will stop those overage fees entirely.
Customer: That sounds perfect. How much will that cost me per month?
Agent: The new monthly price will be 55 dollars, and the change will take effect starting from your next billing cycle on October 1st.
Customer: That is a fair price. Let's go ahead and do that. I also need to pay my current outstanding balance of 20 dollars first.
Agent: Of course. Please go ahead and provide the card details for that payment.
Customer: It is four five three six six three zero six two six one one six nine five seven.
Agent: Thank you. The payment has been processed successfully. I will now process the plan change and send a confirmation SMS to your phone number 94353 96017.
Customer: Thank you so much, Meera. I feel much better now that this is sorted out.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? To recap, we have paid your balance and updated your plan to Unlimited. Have a wonderful day. Goodbye!
